name: MegaFon (PJSC)
note: Russian mobile operator, a PJSC whose shares are no longer publicly traded. Its 2025 IFRS statements (corp.megafon.ru) no longer name the controlling party: the shares are held 50/50 by two Russia-registered companies with a common ultimate controlling entity that itself belongs to a group of participants no one controls alone (disclosure restricted by Russia's 2023 sensitive-information rules).
